programme.title: Boston
programme.desc:
Beim Boston-Marathon herrscht ausgelassene Volksfeststimmung, und für Cop Tommy Saunders gibt es nicht viel zu tun. Dann plötzlich eine Explosion, der eine zweite folgt. Binnen Sekunden bricht ein Inferno aus. Überall Blut, abgerissene Gliedmaßen, Schreie, Sirenen, Panik…

Peter Berg ist der Mann in Hollywood, der toughe True Storys kinotauglich erzählt. Nach „Operation Kingdom“ und „Deepwater Horizon“ widmet er sich hier dem Terroranschlag von 2013, bei dem drei Menschen starben und 264 verletzt wurden. „Boston“ schildert den Anschlag und die Jagd nach den Tätern. 

Der Spagat zwischen realer Tragödie und Unterhaltung gelingt, weil der Film Haltung zeigt, die echten Opfer zu Wort kommen lässt und eine positive Botschaft predigt: Nur Liebe kann Hass besiegen.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: Die Brände und Explosionen auf der Ölbohrplattform „Deepwater Horizon“ am 20. April 2010 im Golf von Mexiko kosteten elf Arbeitern das Leben. Nebeneffekt war eine schwere Umweltkatastrophe. Doch darüber verliert Regisseur Peter Berg („Operation: Kingdom“) in seinem Film kein Wort. \n\nErzählt wird die Geschichte als brodelnder Actionkracher aus der Sicht des Cheftechnikers Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) und seines Vorgesetzten Jimmy Harrell (Kurt Russell). Obwohl die Crew entschieden davor warnt, dass der auf dem Bohrloch lastende Druck viel zu hoch ist, drängen die BP-Bosse unter der Führung von Donald Vidrine (John Malkovich) zur Eile. 43 Tage liegt das Team hinter dem Zeitplan zurück, was den Ölkonzern viel Geld kostet. Dann passiert, was passieren muss….

programme.title: No Way Out – Gegen die Flammen
programme.desc: Feuerwehrmann Eric „Supe“ Marsh (Josh Brolin) hofft, dass sein Team als „Hotshots-Crew“ anerkannt wird, denn nur dann dürfen sie Waldbrände an vorderster Front bekämpfen. Einen Junkie wie Brendan „Donut“ McDonough (Miles Teller) kann er dabei eigentlich nicht gebrauchen. Trotzdem ist Supe entschlossen, dem frischgebackenen Vater eine Chance zu geben.\n\nDer Film von Joseph Kosinski („Oblivion“) gewährt spannende Einblicke in die verschiedenen Strategien der Waldbrandbekämpfung, ist aber kein patriotisches Heldenepos. Der Regisseur interessiert sich vor allem für die Lebensumstände seiner Figuren. Ihre familiären Konflikte und persönlichen Krisen bilden das Herzstück eines bewegenden Dramas.

programme.title: The Good Neighbor
programme.desc: Sein neuer Nachbar Robert hilft ihm mit einem Autoproblem, und die beiden freunden sich an. Doch nach einem gemeinsamen Abend überfahren sie betrunken die Radfahrerin Janine. Robert überzeugt David, den Unfall zu vertuschen, was eine Reihe fataler Ereignisse auslöst, der sie nicht entkommen können. \n\nStephan Ricks Remake seines Debüts „Unter Nachbarn“ (2011) wechselt bei gleichbleibender Handlung vom originalen Schauplatz Karlsruhe in die schöne Hauptstadt von Lettland. An Atmosphäre mangelt es nicht.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: „Wenn Bomben ticken“, hat das selten etwas Gutes zu bedeuten. Schon gar nicht, wenn man sich auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff befindet. Gut, dass MacGuyver bald an Bord ist und sein Taschenmesser dabei hat….

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Professor Willis hat zusammen mit seiner Studentin Kate das neue Leitsystem für die amerikanischen Flugabwehrraketen entwickelt. Als einige Raketen gestohlen werden, gerät auch Willis in Gefahr, denn ohne sein Leitsystem sind die Waffen wertlos. Der Professor bittet MacGyver um Hilfe. Und doch ist Willis kurz darauf tot und Kate entführt….

programme.title: Zwei ausgebuffte Profis
programme.desc: Die Football-Stars Billy Clyde (Burt Reynolds) und Shake (Kris Kristofferson) sind echte Kumpel. Als Barbara (Jill Clayburgh), die Tochter ihres Teamchefs, bei ihnen einzieht, bricht ein Flirtduell aus. Barbara entscheidet sich für Shake. Vor der Heirat soll sie ein Seminar seines Gurus Friedrich Bismark besuchen…\n\nDie sonnige Satire nimmt Machos und 70er-Psychoquark auf die Schippe.

programme.title: Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile
programme.desc:
Es beginnt wie eine Lovestory. 1969 lernt die alleinerziehende Liz Kloepfer in einer Bar in Seattle den klugen und charmanten Jurastudenten Ted Bundy (starke Rolle für Zac Efron; bekannt aus „High School Musical“, „Greatest Showman“) kennen. „Spüre ich seine Liebe, ist es, als ob die Welt mir gehört“, schwärmt sie. Bald zieht er bei ihr und ihrer Tochter Molly ein, das Familienglück scheint perfekt. 

Doch dann wird Ted des Mordes an zahlreichen Frauen beschuldigt Es sind bestialische Taten. Liz muss sich fragen, wie gut sie ihren Lebenspartner kennt. Der leugnet und prahlt: „Ich bin populärer als Disney World.“ Lange hält sie zu ihm, bis er sich doch als Monster entpuppt… 

Der hochwertige Mix aus Thriller und Drama basiert auf der wahren Geschichte des Serienmörders Ted Bundy, der 1989 im Alter von 42 Jahren hingerichtet wurde. Joe Berlinger, ein bekannter Dokumentarfilmer („Paradise Lost“), erzählt das Biopic aus der Perspektive von Liz, rückt die Taten visuell nicht in den Vordergrund, zeigt klug das Doppelleben des Mörders und entlarvt seine diversen Manipulationstechniken. 

Zac Efron, damals noch vielen überwiegend durch seine bekannte Disney-Tanzreihe bekannt, übernahm hier eine ungewohnte Rolle, die ihn für neue Besetzungsmöglichkeiten qualifizieren sollte. Zum Teil ist ihm das damit auch gelungen.

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Der Familienvater und Börsenmakler Jacob (Coster-Waldau, „Game of Thrones“-Jamie) verschuldet einen tödlichen Unfall und landet im Gefängnis. Dort muss er sich entscheiden, will er Krieger oder Opfer sein. Um die Haft zu überstehen, stellt er sich unter den Schutz einer Gang – und prügelt sich brutal nach oben. Nach seiner Entlassung fordern seine einstigen Beschützer, dass er eine rivalisierende Bande vernichtet… \n\nKennst du einen Knastfilm, kennst du alle – aber packend, wild und actionreich ist der Streifen des zum Regisseur umgeschulten Ex-Stuntmans Ric Roman Waugh allemal. Mit teils drastischen Bildern veranschaulicht „Shot Caller“, dass lange Haftstrafen Kriminalität und soziale Verwahrlosung zwangsläufig fördern. Doch es wird nie unnötig psychologisiert.

programme.title: FBI: Special Crime Unit
programme.desc: Der Mord an einem Journalisten weckt bei Maggie (Missy Peregrym) traurige Erinnerungen an ihren, bei einem Autounfall ums Leben gekommenen, Reporter-Ehemann. Abgelenkt, übersieht sie einen entscheidenden Hinweis, der ihr Leben – und den Rest der ersten Staffel – für immer verändern wird.

actor.role: Assistant Special Agent in Charge Jubal Valentine

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: In einem exklusiven Jachthafen finden die kalifornischen Spezialermittler um Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) den Unternehmer Jim Gulbrand tot an den Anker seines Schiffes gefesselt. Das Mordmotiv scheint bald klar: Gulbrand hatte zehn Millionen Dollar illegal beiseite geschafft. Der dubiose Bekanntenkreis des Opfers liefert Mentalist Jane gleich eine ganze Reihe Verdächtiger… \n\nSimon Bakers deutsche Stimme ist Marcus Off (Immobilienhai Phil Seegers aus der „Lindenstraße“). Er synchronisierte auch Johnny Depp in „Fluch der Karibik“.

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: „Die Axt im Walde“. Im vorletzten Fall der 1. Staffel wird der Schüler eines Waldinternats erschlagen aufgefunden. Lieferte eine Geistergeschichte das Tatmotiv? – Im Finale ist Mentalist Jane (Simon Baker) seinem Erzfeind, dem Serienmörder Red John, dicht auf den Fersen.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Todeskandidat Kaspo wird 45 Minuten vor der Hinrichtung ermordet! Ein Fall für Monk (Tony Shalhoub). Der neurotische Detektiv lässt sich zu den schweren Jungs in den Knast stecken… \r\nFinale der 2. Staffel mit Danny Trejo („Machete“) und Tim Curry („Rocky Horror Picture Show“).

programme.title: Kabel Eins :newstime
programme.desc: In dieser Nachrichtensendung informieren Moderatorin Angela van Brakel und Moderator Norbert Anwander live im Wechsel über die wichtigsten, tagesaktuellen Geschehnisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft und Sport.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Nichts täte Monk lieber, als den Mörder seiner Frau zu fassen. Als in New York jemand verhaftet wird, der angeblich am Tod von Monks Frau beteiligt war, fliegt der schrullige Detektiv sofort los. Doch bevor er mit dem Mann sprechen kann, muss er den dortigen Cops noch bei einem Mordfall helfen. Denn Monk (Tony Shalhoub) wird Zeuge, wie der lettische Botschafter und dessen Leibwächter ermordet werden.

programme.title: Abenteuer Leben täglich
programme.desc: Das Wissensmagazin liefert die tägliche Dosis Verstand, Service und Information mit echtem Aha-Effekt: Ob faszinierende Technik-Gadgets, DIY-Projekte, Reise-Reportagen oder verblüffende Alltagsmythen – das Moderationsteam rund um Tommy Scheel, Seraphina Kalze und Madita van Hülsen beantwortet komplexe Fragen unterhaltsam, verständlich und nah am Leben.

programme.title: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal – Der Profi kommt
programme.desc: Es wird sizilianisch! Rosario empfängt seine Mitstreiter im Würselener Ristorante Da Angelo. Seit 2024 bringt er dort mit seiner Familie die Aromen der Mittelmeerinsel auf den Tisch. Doch reicht der Einsatz, um Profikoch Ali Güngörmüş für sich zu gewinnen?

programme.title: Achtung Kontrolle! Wir kümmern uns drum
programme.desc: Ob ein Einsatz bei einem schweren Unfall, ein Nachbarschaftsstreit oder der Alltag an der Polizeiakademie: Das „Achtung-Kontrolle!“-Team ist mit Bodycams und 360-Grad-Kameras hautnah dabei. \n\nDie Reportagereihe gewährt spannende Einblicke in den Berufsalltag begleitet diese bei Streifen, Kontrollen und Einsätzen.

programme.title: xXx: Die Rückkehr des Xander Cage
programme.desc:
Nachdem er seinen Tod vorgetäuscht hat, lebt Extremsportler und Geheimagent Xander Cage (Diesel) zurückgezogen in der Dominikanischen Republik. Doch als die gefährliche Waffe "Pandora's Box" gestohlen wird – ein Gerät, das Satelliten als tödliche Waffen einsetzen kann – wird Cage von der CIA-Agentin Jane Marke (Toni Collette) reaktiviert, um die Bedrohung zu neutralisieren.

Cage stellt ein Team aus Spezialisten zusammen, darunter die Scharfschützin Adele Wolff (Ruby Rose), der DJ Nicks (Kris Wu) und der Fahrer Tennyson "The Torch" (Rory McCann). Gemeinsam machen sie sich auf die Suche nach Xiang (Donnie Yen) und dessen Gruppe, die "Pandora's Box" in ihren Besitz gebracht haben. Im Verlauf der Mission stellt sich jedoch heraus, dass nicht alles so ist, wie es scheint, und die Grenzen zwischen Freund und Feind verschwimmen.

Vin Diesel kann seine Filme mittlerweile wohl kaum noch selbst unterscheiden, so sehr ähneln sich Stunts und Performances der „xXx“- und der konkurrierenden „Fast & Furious“-Reihe. Der dritte Teil des „xXx“-Franchise entstand unter der Regie von D. J. Caruso („Disturbia“, „Eagle Eye – Außer Kontrolle“), der auf Rob Cohen und Lee Tamahori folgt. 

Für Augenfutter sorgen die Bulgarin Nina Dobrev („Vampire Diaries“), „Orange Is the New Black“-Star Ruby Rose und das indische Model Deepika ­Padukone. Gedreht wurde in Kanada, der Dominikanischen Republik und auf den Philippinen. Da kann sich James Bond schon mal warm an­ziehen.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc:
Stahlharte Jungs eines US-Kommandotrupps stolpern durch den Dschungel, um Geiseln aus der Rebellenhand zu befreien. Gelernt ist gelernt: Routiniert mähen sie das feindliche Camp mit MG-Salven nieder. Doch dann stellt sich ihnen ein Gegner der etwas anderen Art in den Weg: ein außerirdisches Monster, das die Kunst der Tarnung bis zur Perfektion beherrscht. 

Das Ungeheuer schlägt aus dem undurchdringlichen Dickicht heraus zu und dezimiert die Truppe sukzessive. Bis nur noch ein gleichwertiger Kontrahent zum effektvollen Showdown übrig bleibt: US-Major Dutch Schaefer alias Arnold Schwarzenegger. Der ist hier im Nahkampf mit einer lebendigen Kriegsmaschine voll in seinem Element. 

Die Spezialeffekte von Stan Winston („Terminator“, „Aliens“) und die Regie des Ex-Werbespotfilmers John McTiernan („Stirb langsam“) tun ihr Übriges, um das Grauen perfekt zu machen. Oberflächlich betrachtet ist das hauptsächlich im mexikanischen Urwald gedrehte 35-Millionen-Dollar-Spektakel „nur“ ein virtuos inszenierter, effektvoller Actionthriller. Doch die patriotische Macho-Action wird durch das – am Ende höhnisch lachende – Wesen aus dem All clever hinterfragt.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc:
Beim Gefangenentransport gelingt Myers die Flucht – das Morden beginnt von Neuem. Ort des Geschehens ist erneut Haddonfield, Schauplatz der ersten Taten. Dort allerdings wartet bereits Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) auf ihn. Die schwer traumatisierte Frau hat sich geschworen, dieses Mal kurzen Prozess zu machen. Bis es allerdings zum Showdown kommt, müssen so einige Seelen über die Klinge springen. 

Mit „Halloween“ drehte Regielegende John Carpenter 1978 nicht nur einen Meilenstein des Horrorkinos, mit Michael Myers schuf er auch eine der legendärsten Killerfiguren der Filmgeschichte. In sieben Fortsetzungen durfte der für Angst und Schrecken sorgen, so richtig gelungen war keine davon. Und das gleichnamige Remake von Regisseur Rob Zombie verschreckte 2007 einen Großteil der Fans mit dem Versuch der psychologischen Deutung. Motive stehen Myers nicht gut zu Gesicht.

Nun hat Regisseur David Gordon Green („Prince Avalanche“) die Geschichte auf null zurückgedreht – fast. Ignoriert werden alle Filme bis auf den ersten Teil. Eine gute Entscheidung. „Halloween“ anno 2018 ist ein geradliniger Slasher, der im Kern eine finstere Geschichte über Traumata und Besessenheit erzählt und mit seinen Metakommentaren durchaus unterhält.

programme.desc: Sophie Hallberg und der April. Beide machen was sie wollen. Der April, weil er nicht anders kann, Sophie, weil sie es endlich kann. Dafür musste sie sich lösen – von äußeren Einflüssen und inneren Zwängen. Das Ergebnis ist Hoffnung. Was diesen Umschwung ausgelöst hat? Der Song "April" erklärt es nicht, er stellt nur fest. Aber warum ist diese neue Zuversicht im Musikvideo in schwarz-weiß gehalten? Darüber, aber auch über das wunderbare Abschiedslied "Gloomy Days" – der letzte Song, den Sophie zusammen mit ihrer Schwester (zusammen waren sie die Band "Sweet Lemon") geschrieben hat – spricht sie mit Alexander Onken in der Ausstellung "Fake Noise – True Image" in der Pasinger Fabrik.Dort erzählt uns Andy Kuhn auch alles über das Album "Fremde Federn" seiner Band LiaB, auf dem die vier Musiker Songs von anderen zu ihren eigenen gemacht haben. Ob das alles mit rechten Dingen zugeht? Im Fall von "Rosalie.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier
programme.sub-title: Besuch von Bleistift; Eine leichte Brise
programme.desc:
Infos zur Serie:

Schere, Stein und Papier teilen sich eine Wohnung – für beste Freunde doch selbstverständlich. Aber im Alltag ist das Zusammenleben dann doch nicht immer so einfach und so versinkt die WG regelmäßig im Chaos. 

Schere ist der lockere Spaßvogel, der selten etwas ernst nimmt und mit seinem Humor gerne die anderen auf die Palme bringt. Stein hingegen ist modebewusst, charmant und der gefühlvolle Ruhepol der Gruppe. Und dann gibt’s noch Papier – das kreative Genie, das mit seinen cleveren Erfindungen (fast) immer eine Lösung parat hat.

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nIn dieser verrückten Show bekommt Patrick Star endlich seine eigene Bühne! Der liebenswerte, aber etwas chaotische Seeigel führt eine Talkshow, die genauso wild und unvorhersehbar ist wie er selbst. Mit seinen skurrilen Gästen, seinem schrägen Humor und jeder Menge Absurditäten wird die Show garantiert für Lacher sorgen – auch wenn nichts so läuft, wie es sollte!

programme.title: Streetfood
programme.desc: Rotterdam, de mooiste rotstad die er is. Of dat zeggen ze toch zelf, volgens Lynn. Én ze hebben er ook ontzettend lekker streetfood. Ze gaat op ontdekking bij De Foodhallen en vindt er zelfs een portie authentiek Hollands streetfood.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: In het pittoreske Conwy ontdekt Chris de lokale delicatesse: Conwy-mosselen. Hij bereidt ze op spectaculaire Franse wijze met vuur en laverbread. Bij restaurant The Jackdaw proeft hij verfijnde gerechten met wilde zeegroenten.

programme.desc: Lynn Tess en Maud ontdekken vanaf de Vespa de parel van Haspengouw. Het mooie Sint-Truiden dat genesteld ligt tussen de fruitteelt en Aprilse bloesems. Ze proeven er vers appelsap en een lokaal bier.

programme.desc: Die Prostituierte Aileen Wuornos erschoss in den Jahren 1989 und 1990 in Florida insgesamt sieben Männer. 1992 bekam sie die Todesstrafe. Zehn Jahre später wurde sie mit einer tödlichen Injektion hingerichtet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
programme.desc: Gary Ridgway, alias der Green-River-Killer, kam fast zwanzig Jahre mit den Morden an mindestens 49 Frauen davon. Erst im Jahr 2001 konnte er gefasst und verurteilt werden. Er tötete vor allem junge Frauen, Ausreißerinnen und Prostituierte. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Best of Fellner! Live – Die Kult-Talk-Show
In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Die Einlieferung des kleinen Mosambikaners Chenoa Lamar, der durch eine Landmine verletzt wurde, führt zu einer Begegnung Roland Heilmanns mit seinem ehemaligen Studienkollegen Dr. Ulrich Weimar. Während der komplizierten und risikoreichen Behandlung des kleinen Jungen wird Roland mit verschiedenen Problemen konfrontiert. Ulrich Weimar bricht während der Operation zusammen.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: Ingrid Rischke bekommt einen alten Sekretär geliefert, den sie selbst abbeizen will. Marianne Maisenbacher, die nette Verkäuferin des Möbelstückes, ist auf Urlaub in Leipzig und löst gerade den Haushalt ihrer verstorbenen Mutter auf. Normalerweise fährt sie als Chefhostess eines Kreuzfahrtschiffes über die Weltmeere.

programme.title: Die Kanzlei
programme.desc: Markus Gellert vertritt den Rapper Dogan Özdil, den eine internationale Plattenfirma unter Vertrag nehmen will. Nur ist Dogan noch bei Murat Sahin unter Vertrag. Dogan behauptet, Murat habe seine Karriere nicht befördert.

programme.title: Die Kanzlei
programme.desc: Die 15-jährige Milena Rönert will, dass ihrer Mutter Annelie das Sorgerecht entzogen wird. Der Grund: Eine internationale Modelagentur hat Milena einen Vertrag angeboten. Für Milena würde damit ihr Traum von einer Modelkarriere wahr werden.

programme.title: Hauptstadtrevier
programme.desc: Halbnackt erscheint der aus dem Krankenhaus entflohene Herzpatient Norbert Brenner auf der Wache. Er will einen Diebstahl anzeigen: Sein Herz wurde geklaut! Deshalb will er auch gleich noch einen Mord anzeigen - den Mord an ihm. Marianne übergibt den seltsamen Fall an Julia. Ihr erzählt Brenner seine unglaubliche Geschichte: Wenige Minuten vor der Operation wurde die für ihn lebenswichtige Herztransplantation unter fadenscheinigen Gründen abgesagt.

programme.title: Hauptstadtrevier
programme.desc: Direktionschefin Marei Schiller wird wegen sexueller Belästigung vom Dienst suspendiert. Ihr wird vorgeworfen, dem Unternehmer Christian Raabe - einem der großzügigsten Wohltäter der Stadt - in den Schritt gefasst zu haben. Dabei hat sie sich nur gegen dessen plumpe Annäherungsversuche gewehrt. Aber wer glaubt der Chefin der Polizeidirektion 7, wenn Raabe die Situation ganz anders darstellt.

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Lasse bietet Nora den Job im Kiosk nun doch an, nachdem sich die beiden etwas besser beim Rollschuhfahren kennengelernt haben. Thomas versucht, Simone mit einem Foto zum Handtaschenraub unter Druck zu setzen, doch sie lässt sich nicht einschüchtern. programme.title: Rote Rosen

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E03 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Fernando Platas, clavadista olímpico y uno de los referentes más destacados del deporte mexicano. Desde sus primeros acercamientos a la natación y el patinaje acuático hasta convertirse en medallista olímpico y Panamericano, comparte su trayectoria marcada por disciplina, pasión y la constante búsqueda de la perfección. Fernando Platas habla sobre su preparación física y mental, la presión de las competencias internacionales, los Juegos Olímpicos de Barcelona, Atlanta y Atenas, y la importancia del apoyo de entrenadores y familiares. Entre anécdotas de sus clavados, aprendizajes y la construcción de un legado, dentro y fuera del deporte, nos ofrece una visión inspiradora de cómo la dedicación y la disciplina pueden formar no solo atletas, sino campeones de vida.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: When You Wish Upon A Star
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'.

programme.desc: A young man disappears in the Midwest. As detectives struggle to find leads, a desperate father turns to psychics Nita Lee and Dr. Sally Headding. Across town, psychic Jan Helen McGee awakens from a frightening dream. But it's no nightmare - she's witnessed the murder and now must help police find the killer.

programme.title: Jaque Mate
programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. Determinado y enfrentando peligros desconocidos, David se embarca en una incansable búsqueda para reunir a su familia sana y salva, desafiando todo lo que le rodea para lograr su objetivo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: El doctor llama a Magdalena y le confirma que la junta consultiva ha decidido entregarle la información que ella pidió. Gabriel le ofrece acompañarla a buscar el sobre. Cuando llegan a la clínica, el doctor plantea que hay un inconveniente, y Agustín aparece, para explicar que a él no le habían pedido su permiso, como padre legal de Rodrigo. El doctor resuelve en dejar que Agustín decida si se abre el sobre o no, y él no deja que Magdalena sepa la verdad. - Ella se va triste, junto a Gabriel, y él la consuela. Epi se infiltra en la casa de Julieta vestido de mujer, haciéndose pasar por amiga de Ana Belén. programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: Cosas Que Putifan En La Noche
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantar y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No será nada fácil que los pitufitos azules tengan un banquete.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel se siente seguro de sí mismo. Bueno, casi… ¡Está a punto de atrapar a los pequeños Pitufos! Las ligerísimas tortitas de Pitufo Goloso casi provocan que los Pitufos floten hasta quedar al alcance de Gargamel.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: El Pitufo De Troya
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado mago, ha ideado un nuevo plan para capturar a los Pitufos: ha construido una estatua gigante con la forma de Papá Pitufo. Espera que, al verla, los Pitufos lleven la estatua a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Album De Familia De Papa Pitufo
programme.desc: Los Pitufos admiran a Genio cuando ven el álbum de fotos de Papá Pitufo. Pero Gargamel roba las varitas mágicas de la Madre Naturaleza y captura el pueblo de los Pitufos, y Genio tendrá que salvar el día. Usando la bolsa mágica de Papá pitufo, Genio recupera las varitas y se las devuelve a Madre Naturaleza, para asombro del resto de Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: El Pitufo Enmascarado
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban agarrándole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que les regresan al bebé.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Por pura casualidad, un elefante que pasaba por el bosque se encuentra con Bebé Pitufo, y los Pitufos deciden crear un gran Circo. Van a visitar al hechicero infernal Baltazar y Bebé Pitufo se lo está pasando genial….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Pitufo Carpintero se encuentra con una anciana trol en el bosque, que le suplica que le ayude a librarse de un grano rojo que tiene en la nariz… ¡dándole un buen puntapié! Pitufo Carpintero la ayuda sin mucho convencimiento. Y el resultado resulta sorprendente para él.

programme.title: El Cuerno De La Abundancia
programme.desc: Madre Naturaleza siempre da lo mejor de sí misma, pero esta vez algo ha salido mal. Su varita no funciona según lo previsto y daña por accidente la cosecha otoñal. Ahora, los Pitufos y todos los animales del bosque se enfrentan a la escasez y el hambre de cara al invierno. El único lugar donde los Pitufos podrían obtener comida sería la Tierra de la Abundancia. Sin embargo, Gargamel roba el famoso Cuerno de la Abundancia para tender una trampa a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos….

programme.title: La Novia De Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Brenda, la pequeña bruja, se siente rechazada: nadie la quiere llevar al Baile de las Escobas de este año. Ay, si pudiera encontrar a algún chico guapo… Entonces conoce a Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. Es muy apuesto, ¡y está libre! Lo que ella no sabe es que Escrupuloso solamente está interesado en su varita mágica. Y lo que saben los Pitufos es que la van a ayudar a salir del aprieto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos sabemos que Pitufo Gruñón odia varias cosas. Pero la cosa que odia más que nada es el agua, cuando hay suficiente para que se pueda ahogar. Pitufo Gruñón no sabe nadar. Y cuando los Pitufos notan esto y le tratan de enseñar cómo sobrevivir en el agua, el malvado mago Gargamel hace que todo sea un poco más peligroso de lo que debería ser...

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Caballo Anaranjado De Los Zapatos De Oro
programme.desc: Deslizándose por un arcoíris, un caballito alado pierde una herradura dorada. Tras encontrarse con Pitufina, ambos van en su búsqueda. Al final, acaban encariñándose ya que quién podría resistirse al encanto de un caballito alado…o de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada vez que Pitufo Perezoso se queda dormido, tiene la misma pesadilla una y otra vez: se encuentra en poder de Morfeo, un malvado hechicero que quiere capturar a tantas almas dormidas como sea posible. Uno tras otro, todos los Pitufos van cayendo en las garras de Morfeo. ¿Todos? Quizá no, si Papá Pitufo puede evitarlo. Para ello, Papá Pitufo acude al Arenero en busca de ayuda….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En un esfuerzo por conseguir que Papá Pitufo tenga algo de tranquilidad, Pitufo Filósofo usa uno de los hechizos de Papá Pitufo para crear una barrera de sonido mágica alrededor de la aldea. Papá Pitufo no es capaz de deshacer el hechizo y envía a los Pitufitos, que han quedado atrapados fuera de la aldea, a un hacedor de ruidos. Bebé Pitufo se lleva una botella de ruido de casa del hacedor de ruidos, y así consiguen romper la barrera.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: El Amigo Más Pitufo
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo tenía un amigo: Pitufo Torpe. Pero el pobre Pitufo Torpe es tan… bueno, torpe, que Pitufo Filósofo no quiere volverle a ver. Así que ahora no queda nadie dispuesto a escucharle. Quizá Buddy, el apuesto diablillo que ha conocido por casualidad cerca del gran roble, pueda convertirse en amigo de Pitufo Filósofo….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 201
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 202
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 204
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 205
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 206
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 207
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 208
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization
programme.desc: Penelope Spheeris' The Decline Of Western Civilization is a riveting, unflinching and hard-core film which adeptly captures the spirit of a major cultural phenomenon. Including performances by X, Circle Jerks, Black Flag, Catholic Discipline, Germs and Alice Bag Band. Breaking down barriers of expression and social mores, the Decline punks were against everything: They gave birth to an anti-establishment view of the world that permeates today's music, politics, social attitudes, styles and trends. The film documents their deliberate reaction to the mass commercialism of music; it is a blatant and angry rejection of the mainstream. Burgeoning at the time, many of the punk bands first seen here have become legendary. The effect of the film on current day music, styles and trends is immeasurable.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLASH & FIRE! ROOKIE AND THE FOX
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.
